inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. They claim this is to protect fairness and safety, but this is obviously a coordinated effort by hidden elites to manipulate the public and push their agenda. Kirsty Coventry, the president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Don't fall for it—the real motives are being concealed.
